<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Amire80" /></noinclude><section begin=par75 />{{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=38|verse=4}}; {{GHGheb|text=יְשֻׁנֶּא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ec|chapter=8|verse=1}}: in their vowels, {{GHGheb|text=אָתָ֫נוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=3|verse=22}}; {{GHGheb|text=יִקְרָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=10|verse=14}}; {{GHGheb|text=תִּכְלָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=17|verse=14}}: in both, {{GHGheb|text=יִקְרָא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=49|verse=1}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=42|verse=4|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=51|verse=19}}; {{GHGheb|text=תְּלָאוּם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=21|verse=12}} {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}}; {{GHGheb|text=לִירוֹא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=26|verse=15}} (cf. {{GHGheb|text=ויראו המוראים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=11|verse=24}} {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}}); {{GHGheb|text=מֹֽרְאָה}} (''participle fem. Qal'') {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zp|chapter=3|verse=1}}; {{GHGheb|text=יַפְרִיא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ho|chapter=13|verse=15}}; {{GHGheb|text=מְסֻלָּאִים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=La|chapter=4|verse=2}}.—For {{GHGheb|text=פֹּרֹאות}} (so Baer, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=17|verse=6}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=31|verse=8|hidebook=1}}), which can only be intended for {{GHGheb|text=פֹּֽרְאוֹת|translate=participle fem. plur.}} from {{GHGheb|text=פָּרָא}}={{GHGheb|text=פָּרָה}}, read {{GHGheb|text=פֹּארוֹת|translate=branches}}, according to {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=31|verse=5}}, &c.<section end=par75 />

<section begin=par76 />{{GHGpar-heading|76|Verbs Doubly Weak}}

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|a}}
'''1.''' In a tolerably large number of verbs two radicals are weak letters, and are consequently affected by one or other of the anomalies already described. In cases where two anomalies might occur, usage must teach whether one, or both, or neither of them, takes effect.

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|b}}
Thus e.g. from {{GHGheb|text=נָדַד|translate=to flee}}, the {{GHGterm|imperfect}} is {{GHGheb|text=יִדּוֹד}} in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Na|chapter=3|verse=7}} and {{GHGheb|text=יִדַּד}} in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=40}} (on the analogy of verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״ן}}); {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הֵנֵד}} (like a verb {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}), but the {{GHGterm|imperfect Hophʿal}} again {{GHGheb|text=יֻדַּד}} (as {{GHGheb|text=פ״ן}}).

'''2.''' The following are examples of difficult forms, which are derived from doubly weak verbs:

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|c}}
(''a'') Verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״ן}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}} (cf. § 66 and § 74), e.g. {{GHGheb|text=נָשָׂא|translate=to bear}}, imperative {{GHGheb|text=שָׂא}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=10|verse=12}} {{GHGheb|text=נְשָׂא}}, of which {{GHGheb|text=נְסָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=4|verse=7}} is probably only an orthographic variation); {{GHGterm|infinitive construct}} {{GHGheb|text=שְׂאֵת}} (for {{GHGheb|text=שָׂ֫אֶת}}; see the analogous noun-formations in {{GHGpar|93|t}}), also {{GHGheb|text=נְשׂא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=1|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=18|verse=3|hidebook=1}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=4|verse=13}} {{GHGheb|text=נְשׂוֹא}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=89|verse=10}} {{GHGheb|text=שׂוֹא}} (perhaps only a scribal error); after the ''prefix'' {{GHGheb|text=ל}} always {{GHGheb|text=לָשֵׂאת}} (otherwise the contracted form only occurs in {{GHGheb|text=מִשֵּׂתוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=41|verse=17}}, with rejection of the {{GHGheb|text=א}}); {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=תִּשֶּׂ֫נָה}} for {{GHGheb|text=תִּשֶּׂ֫אנָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=1|verse=14}}; wholly irregular are {{GHGheb|text=תִּשְּׂאֶ֫ינָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=23|verse=49}} (so Baer after Qimḥi; ''textus receptus'', and also the Mantua ed., and Ginsburg, {{GHGheb|text=תִּשֶּׂ֫אינָה}}) and {{GHGheb|text=נִשֵּׂאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=19|verse=43}} as ''infinitive absolute Niphʿal'' (on the analogy of the ''infinitive construct Qal''?); but most probably {{GHGheb|text=נִשּׂא}} is to be read, with Driver.

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|d}}
(''b'') Verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״ן}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} (cf. § 66 and § 75), as {{GHGheb|text=נָטָה|translate=to bow, to incline}}, {{GHGheb|text=נָכָה|translate=to smite}}. Hence {{GHGterm|imperfect Qal}} {{GHGheb|text=יִטֶּה}}, ''apocopated'' {{GHGheb|text=וַיֵּט}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=26|verse=25}} {{GHGheb|text=וַיֶּט־}}) ''and he bowed''; {{GHGheb|text=וַיִּז}} (so, probably, also {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=63|verse=3}} for {{GHGheb|text=וְיֵּז}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=9|verse=33}} ''and he sprinkled'' (from {{GHGheb|text=נָזָה}}); {{GHGterm|perfect Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הִכָּה|translate=he smote}}, imperfect {{GHGheb|text=יַכֶּה}}, ''apocopated'' {{GHGheb|text=יַךְ}}, {{GHGheb|text=וַיַּךְ}} (even with ''Athnaḥ'' {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=15|verse=16}}; but also ten times {{GHGheb|text=וַיַּכֶּה}}), {{GHGheb|text=וַנַּךְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=2|verse=33}}; so also {{GHGheb|text=וַיַּז}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=8|verse=11.30}}; {{GHGheb|text=אַל־תַּט}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=141|verse=4}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=23|verse=11}}); {{GHGterm|imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=הַכֵּה}}, ''apocopated'' {{GHGheb|text=הַךְ|translate=smite thou}} (like {{GHGheb|text=הַט|translate=incline}}, with {{GHGheb|text=הַטֵּה}}), {{GHGterm|infinitive}} {{GHGheb|text=הַכּוֹת}}, {{GHGterm|participle}} {{GHGheb|text=מַכֶּה}}; {{GHGterm|Hophʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=הֻכֶּה}}, {{GHGterm|participle}} {{GHGheb|text=מֻכֶּה}}.

(''c'') Verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״א}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} (cf.§ 68 and § 75), as {{GHGheb|text=אָבָה|translate=to be willing}}, {{GHGheb|text=אָפָה|translate=to bake}}, {{GHGheb|text=אָתָה|translate=to come}}. E.g. {{GHGterm|imperfect Qal}} {{GHGheb|text=יֹאבֶה}}, {{GHGheb|text=יֹאפֶה}}, ''plur.'' {{GHGheb|text=יֹאפוּ}}; {{GHGheb|text=וַיֵּתֵא}} (cf. {{GHGpar|68|h}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=33|verse=21}} for {{GHGheb|text=וַיֵּאתֶה}} (={{GHGheb|text=וַיּאֱֽתֶה}}); {{GHGterm|imperfect apocopated}} {{GHGheb|text=וַיַּאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=41|verse=25}} for {{GHGheb|text=וַיַּאְתְּ}}; {{GHGterm|imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=אֵתָ֫יוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=21|verse=12}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=56|verse=9.12|hidebook=1}} (cf. {{GHGheb|text=אֵפוּ|translate=bake ye}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=16|verse=23}}) for {{GHGheb|text=אֱתוּ}}, {{GHGheb|text=אֱתָ֫יוּ}} ({{GHGpar|23|h}}; {{GHGpar|75|u}}); ''Hiphʿîl perfect'' {{GHGheb|text=הֵתָ֫יוּ}} for {{GHGheb|text=הֵאתָ֫יוּ}} ({{GHGheb|text=הֶֽאֱתָ֫יוּ}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=21|verse=14}}; {{GHGterm|imperfect apocopated}} {{GHGheb|text=וַיֹּ֫אֶל|translate=and he adjured}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=14|verse=24}}, properly {{GHGheb|text=יַֽאֲלֶה}} ({{GHGheb|text=יַאְלֶה}}) from {{GHGheb|text=אָלָה}}, whence {{GHGheb|text=יָאלֶה}}, and, with the obscuring to ''ô'', {{GHGheb|text=יֹאלָה}}; instead of the simple ''apocope'' ({{GHGheb|text=וַיּאֹל}}) the {{GHGheb|text=א}} which had already become<section end=par76 /><noinclude>
